original_description: Give Montage a URL or a Google Drive link and it pulls the video in and watches the import until it's done. From there, ask for a moment. It cuts the clip and replies with an editor link, so you can trim it or fix the styling before you post it anywhere.
summary_ja: URLやGoogle Driveのリンクから動画を取り込み、指定した場面を切り抜いて編集用リンクを返す。
limitations: 実際の動作・料金・対応形式は未検証。
Google Driveの共有範囲やアクセス条件は未確認。
